description: Circle of the Land Druids are masters of natural magic, channeling the power of forests, mountains, and oceans to protect and restore.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: You learn one additional Druid cantrip of your choice.

features.name: Land Spells
features.description: You gain bonus Druid spells based on your circle type (Forest, Grassland, Mountain, etc.). These spells are always prepared.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: When you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots up to half your Druid level (round up).

features.name: Nature Shelter
features.description: You and your companions gain resistance to environmental damage and can survive without food or water in your circle's terrain.
